title: test(metadata-admin): unit-test the flow data-picker token insertion (#1934)
body:
Hardening for the flow data-picker ([#1973](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/1973)+).

Extracts the cursor-splice math from `VariableTextInput` into a pure **`insertToken`** helper and unit-tests it (and `formatToken`) directly — the picker's core UX contract, previously only exercised manually / in the browser:
- bare CEL (`record.amount`) in `expression` fields vs `{record.amount}` in template fields;
- append at caret, mid-string insert, selection-replace;
- clamping a reversed or out-of-range selection so it can never corrupt the value.

Pure refactor — no behavior change; the DOM focus/caret restore stays in the component. `pnpm build` (tsc) clean; inspectors suite green (172).
